# Avsnitt 607 - Noteringen som inte får misslyckas

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-11-17  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts talk through a sharp risk-off day, with OMX down about 1.7-2%. Pressure on AI stocks centres on the Nvidia CEO scandal, with Jensen Huang forced out and the CFO stepping in as acting CEO, plus concerns about China chip smuggling and Anthropic's IPO draining liquidity. They expect a strong bounce within a week to a month, helped by the Christmas-rally flows, and prefer trading indexes over picking single AI names. Other topics: First North buyback rules from early December (Coffee Stain, Surgical Science), Klarna's Q3 report, and buying crypto and gold on the weakness.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 SUS — Surgical Science | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

EGM called. First North buybacks allowed from about Dec 5. Overcapitalised companies can support their share price.

#### Reasoning

Host flags the new First North buyback rules as a theme in a weak market where marginal buyers are disappearing. Overcapitalised, cheaply valued companies can buy back shares to support the price. Surgical Science calling an EGM suggests it may be preparing a buyback.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no buyback mandate is approved
- if the shares trade expensive

> *"Och där tittar jag framförallt på Coffee Stain och Surgical Science för tillfället."*

---

### 🟠 COFFEE-B — Coffee Stain | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Large cash pile, AGM called. Buyback candidate under the new First North rules.

#### Reasoning

Host sees Coffee Stain as an overcapitalised First North company that could buy back shares once the rules change in early December, supporting the price in a weak market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no buyback is launched
- if the valuation is not cheap

> *"jag såg Coffee Stain kallade till stämma de har ju stor kassa"*

---

### 🟡 KLAR — Klarna | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host owns a little. Q3 beat, card growth +500%, 122M customers, big CEO insider buy. Shares look cheap but no catalyst yet.

#### Reasoning

Shares are far below the 50 IPO price and the large customer base needs better monetisation. CEO insider buying signals he sees value. The host is waiting for the 'hockey stick' turn and for the market to reward the company, possibly via a bid. Calls it dead money for now but super interesting.

#### Sell Triggers

- if monetisation per customer fails to improve
- if guidance is cut further

> *"Jag tycker fortfarande att det här är ett superintressant play."*

---

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

CEO ousted, China probe. Possible panic-dip bounce trade, but crowded overhang and lasting uncertainty. 'Too hard bucket'.

#### Reasoning

Hosts note past big drops were buying opportunities and that tonight's report numbers will be strong. But Jensen's exit hurts Nvidia's role as the financing engine, a congressional hearing and lawsuits are coming, and positioning is heavily crowded. They might trade a bounce but do not want a short.

#### Sell Triggers

- further China smuggling revelations
- financing for neocloud customers tightens
- lawsuits after the congressional hearing

> *"Jag är inte varken baissad eller, det hamnar väl lite i too hard bucket liksom."*

---

### 🟢 AMD — AMD | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host traded some today. Talk of customers replacing Nvidia; should bounce well in an AI rebound.

#### Reasoning

AMD has held up relatively well and could take share if customers switch away from Nvidia. The host bought it as a short-term AI bounce trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI sentiment keeps deteriorating
- if no AI bounce materialises

> *"Jag handlar lite AMD idag."*

---

### ⛔ NBIS — Nebius | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host sold it. Says neoclouds don't control their own destiny and most will go to hell now that Nvidia's financing role is gone.

#### Reasoning

The neocloud business model depends on circular financing from Nvidia. With Jensen gone and the CFO more cautious with money, plus higher rates, financing risk is rising.

> *"Nej, jag tror att de flesta neokloudbolagen kommer att gå åt helvete."*
